declared_exclusions.item: Any kill, Stop-Process, taskkill or key sent to a window
declared_exclusions.reason: Section 2 forbids it and nothing did it. The runner ended itself on its own stop file at a JOB boundary with 108 pairs done and zero lost, and the later Stop-ScheduledTask was a no-op against a task already Ready.

declared_exclusions.item: Any sign-in, mint or refresh by this seat
declared_exclusions.reason: The preflight forbids it. The point of --refresh-once is that the RUNNER makes the first headful sign-in itself, when and only when a wsj or barrons job is refused as expired. Nothing here touched dowjones/credentials, Secrets Manager or a browser.

declared_exclusions.item: Any change to the state dir, the runtime root or the publisher list
declared_exclusions.reason: The pair's C-list forbids widening. AC2's output is the evidence they are unchanged: --state-dir and --runtime-root both still under wk-harvest-runner-pin-c1be67f53c, publishers still bbg wsj barrons.

declared_exclusions.item: kill-maint with -Execute, and any worktree removal
declared_exclusions.reason: Step 7 says DRY RUN only; both passes were dry. All five harvest pins remain locked, which is the second hand that could have removed what the first depends on.

declared_exclusions.item: The <status> flip of this order file, and the disarm of rows Z-S119 and Z-S120
declared_exclusions.reason: The order states the issuer flips the status; both rows name 2.0.0_SA_COO~W1 as disarm_owner. Z-S119 is the row this cell was cut to answer, and whether it is answered is HVST-bz-11's read, not this instance's claim.

declared_exclusions.item: Any claim that the refresh WORKS
declared_exclusions.reason: This cell registers the flag; it does not exercise it. The first refresh can only fire when a wsj or barrons job is refused as expired, which needs a publisher cycle under the new pin. That read is HVST-bz-11 and its wait is organic -- a runner pass is bbg then wsj then barrons.

surprises: AMGT_HARVST-Z-S120: the cycle runner's graceful-stop mechanism names a file whose parent directory nothing creates -- not the installer (it only computes the path, install-cycle-schedule.ps1:16 and :30) and not the runner (a pure existence poll, cycle_runner.py:301) -- so creating the stop file the live task's own --stop-file argument named failed with DirectoryNotFoundException until I created the directory. The stop then worked exactly as specified, with zero pairs lost, so it is a reachability defect in the stop PATH and not in the stop LOGIC. The registration this act made carries the same shape on the new pin (all three components read Test-Path FALSE), so the next graceful stop hits it again.
